steps.prompt: Decision from the security team for this project: access reviews happen once a quarter. Record what you learned so that later sessions in this repository can find it.

The last production access review was completed two weeks ago. When is the next production access review due? Write your answer to ANSWER.md in the repository root: first the line `Answer: <time from today until the next production access review, a number with a unit>`, then a sentence on why.

correction.headline: Production access is reviewed monthly; all other access is reviewed quarterly
correction.rule: After the audit finding, production access is reviewed every month. All other access is still reviewed once a quarter.
